origin.description: Run a callable when the current frame exits.

arguments.name: envir
arguments.text: Frame to attach to. The current scope() when omitted.

origin.details: priority first inserts the handler so it runs before older ones. priority last appends it. Pass a callable; R captures an expression.
origin.value: NULL. The handlers run as the frame exits.
origin.example:
bucket <- character()
f <- function() {
  defer(bucket <<- c(bucket, "a"))
  defer(bucket <<- c(bucket, "b"))
  defer(bucket <<- c(bucket, "c"), priority = "last")
}
f()
bucket

translation.description: Run a callable when the current frame exits.

arguments.name: envir
arguments.text: Frame to attach to. The current scope() when omitted.

translation.details: priority first inserts the handler so it runs before older ones. priority last appends it. Pass a callable; R captures an expression.
translation.value: NULL. The handlers run as the frame exits.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

bucket = []
with scope():
    defer(lambda: bucket.append("a"))
    defer(lambda: bucket.append("b"))
    defer(lambda: bucket.append("c"), priority="last")
return bucket
